name: bounty-target-bootstrap
description: Bootstrap a whitebox or Android bounty target from a program URL with Playwright MCP, local scope capture, source pull, and Bounty Hunting Program handoff.

interface.longDescription: Use Playwright MCP to read a scope page, persist the normalized target in-repo, clone source or APK artifacts, and prepare the next Bounty Hunting Program lane.
defaultPrompt: Open this bounty scope URL with Playwright and bootstrap the target locally
Normalize this Android scope page and download the in-scope APK artifacts
Clone the whitebox source repos from this program page and prepare the next bounty lane
